card.name: Sex-specific hormone therapy wording
card.fires_on: The word right after a sex-linked noun in hormone-therapy text, mostly "with" after "a woman" before "a uterus", or "in" after testosterone before "men". It also fires inside some cancer-drug names like tamoxifen and pertuzumab.

modes.label: Woman with a uterus
modes.description: The link word after "woman" in estrogen-therapy endometrial cancer warnings, leading into a sex-specific body part.
modes.example: An increased risk of endometrial cancer has been reported with the use of unopposed estrogen therapy in a woman<< with>> a uterus.

modes.label: Hormone therapy for men or women
